Neither catchable from plan prose; critique required independent grep/read. Success for multi-agent critique; signals architecture critiques must audit factual claims against code, not trust citations.

Task-8 commit widened an assertion to 21 tools but left the line unformatted; biome check RED at review time. One-line lint:fix cost a full review round. Signal: builder lint did not hold at push time (not re-run after the last edit). Candidate: enforce lint as the final gate immediately before push.
